name: Graperoot
description: Dual-graph code context engine for Claude Code. Builds a structural call graph and dependency graph of your codebase, then delivers precise file and symbol recommendations before Claude starts exploring. Reduces token usage by up to 60% and improves code accuracy by guiding Claude to the right files first. Supports TypeScript, JavaScript, Python, Go, Rust, Java, C/C++, and 10+ more languages. Install via pip, no source code required, fully compiled
longDescription:
Ships **1 skill**, **1 hook** and **1 MCP server**.

- **Skills** (1): `graph-context` (Dual-graph code context retrieval)
- **Hooks** (1): `hooks.json`
- **MCP servers** (1): `dual-graph`

Installs with `claude plugin install graperoot@claude-community` from `kunal12203/graperoot-plugin`.
